title: PrePrMultispectrumChecklist
description: Machine-readable pre-PR gate. Every changeset / session declaring 'done' MUST fill this template and submit it to the seam lane at /evidence/multispectrum/<change_id>-<unix_ts>.json. Lane sub-check `multispectrum-evidence-attached` refuses promotion unless this template is fully filled per the rigor matrix for the declared change_class.

instructions_for_agent.step_1_declare_change_class: Set fields.change_class_id to ONE of CC-1..CC-7. Lane refuses if absent or non-canonical.
instructions_for_agent.step_2_capture_context: Fill git_sha (40-char HEAD SHA), freshness_unix (current epoch seconds), session_id, multispectrum_spec_version.
instructions_for_agent.step_3_evaluate_facets: For each of F1..F7, follow rigor from rigor_matrix[change_class_id]. 'deep' requires at least one finding OR explicit null_finding_reason. 'scan' requires considered=true. 'skip' requires considered=false AND not_applicable_reason.
instructions_for_agent.step_4_iterative_fix_loop: While any required facet is RED, apply iterative-fix-loop.json state machine until all-facets-green. Emit fixtures_added entries; record states_visited.
instructions_for_agent.step_6_submit: Write filled instance to /evidence/multispectrum/<change_id>-<unix_ts>.json. Run `cargo run -p oya-check-dependency-seam -- --mode=composite --offline`. Lane must exit 0.
instructions_for_agent.step_7_close_claim: Only after lane exit 0: `grit done --agent <id>` (closes claim; promotion path per ADR-0054).

template_instance.change_summary: <REQUIRED — one paragraph: what changed and why>
template_instance.change_class_id: <REQUIRED — one of CC-1_kernel_public_api | CC-2_adapter_or_infrastructure | CC-3_application_or_domain | CC-4_refactor_pure | CC-5_doc_only | CC-6_generated_or_vendored | CC-7_test_or_fixture>
template_instance.git_sha: <REQUIRED — 40-char SHA of HEAD at evidence emit time>

findings: <string — each finding for special cases / data structure essentialness / redundant state>
fixuptasks: <F-<SHORT>-<n> bounded id; cited in IP markdown or follow-up registry>

F3_adversarial.failing_fixture_added: <bool — required true for CC-1 and CC-7 lane sub-checks>
F3_adversarial.failing_fixture_id: <string — e.g., crate::tests::violation_case OR fixture directory path>
F3_adversarial.diagnostic_asserted: <string — the specific error/panic/diagnostic the failing fixture asserts>

alternatives_named: <string — at least 1 required; each describes a real alternative considered>

F7_security.owasp_class_review: <enum — dos | injection | broken_access | sensitive_data | crypto | xxe | deserialization | configuration | component_vuln | logging | none_applicable>

mandatory_artifacts._describes: Populate the subset matching the declared change_class per /specs/multispectrum-review.json#change_classes.*.mandatory_artifacts
mandatory_artifacts.symbol_set_parity_diff: <path to before/after diff for CC-4 pure refactor>

template_instance.decision_log_row: <one-line Linus-style: special cases eliminated, rejected antipatterns, why this changeset chose what it chose>

lane_validation_rules.syntactic: Instance MUST validate against /specs/multispectrum-review.json#evidence_schema. Missing required fields = REJECT.
lane_validation_rules.rigor_matrix: For each facet, depth = /specs/multispectrum-review.json#change_classes[change_class_id].rigor_per_facet[facet_id]. 'deep' requires findings.length >= 1 OR null_finding_reason set. 'scan' requires considered = true. 'skip' requires considered = false AND not_applicable_reason set.
lane_validation_rules.adversarial_fixture_requirement: If change_class_id ∈ {CC-1, CC-7}, F3.failing_fixture_added MUST be true.
lane_validation_rules.freshness: freshness_unix MUST be within 24 hours of lane invocation time (prevents stale evidence reuse).
lane_validation_rules.git_sha_match: git_sha MUST match HEAD at lane invocation (prevents evidence pre-baking before actual change).

decision_log.what_changed: Pre-PR checklist converted from human markdown to machine-readable JSON template
decision_log.why: User directive 2026-05-14: 'we are prioritizing machine readable / machine optimized files. minimize markdowns when it makes sense.' Pre-PR checklist is a fillable form consumed by the seam lane — JSON is the correct shape. The markdown version at /templates/checklists/pre-pr-multispectrum.md is RETIRED for tool consumption (kept temporarily as human onboarding gateway; remove when authors are familiar).
